mapper.select: SELECT m.merchant_id, m.merchant_code, c.category_id, c.category_code, p.category_id AS parent_category_id, p.category_code AS parent_category_code FROM merchant m JOIN category c ON c.category_id = m.category_id LEFT JOIN category p ON p.category_id = c.parent_category_id WHERE m.merchant_id = #{merchantId}

SELECT c.category_id, c.category_code, p.category_id AS parent_category_id, p.category_code AS parent_category_code FROM category c LEFT JOIN category p ON p.category_id = c.parent_category_id WHERE c.category_id = #{categoryId}
